visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a tan blazer over a white top and pearls, stands in a medical-style room. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy, using frequent hand gestures. Bright green text overlays the center. (2) The camera pans slightly as she points to a medical monitor displaying an ultrasound scan of skin layers. A finger points to specific numeric depth indicators on the touch screen. (3) The woman returns to a frontal view, continuing her energetic explanation while holding her fingers up to her face to demonstrate thin skin. Graphic icons like checkmarks and emotional descriptors appear. (4) The scene cuts between close-ups of her speaking and the medical monitor. The background remains a brightly lit clinic with professional equipment labeled 'CRYOMED'. (5) A static final screen appears with the clinic's logo, social media handles, telephone numbers, and addresses in Traditional Chinese and English.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide professional medical advice to individuals with thin facial features who are considering cosmetic skin tightening treatments. It explains why deeper ultrasound treatments may be unsuitable and harmful for thin skin while suggesting safer alternatives like Sofwave, ultimately positioning the clinic as a knowledgeable authority.
